requirements.text: Allow students to check the availability of books and materials online.
Enable students to borrow and return items without needing to visit the desk.
Allow students to book study rooms online.
Accommodate unique cases like lost items or special fines that require personal attention.
Ensure compliance with existing policies for managing fines and outstanding balances.
Manage inventory effectively by adding or updating items easily.
Generate reports on borrowing trends, such as the most popular items.
